videos.text:
🥙 Chicken Pita Sandwich (High-Protein, Low-Calorie Lunch) 🤭 tracking with @tryfithub 
This is the perfect high-protein, low-calorie lunch that will keep you full for hours at work. It's very easy to make and packs in a great balance of nutrients without weighing you down ☺️

🔸 Nutrition (per serving):
* Calories: 418 kcal
* Protein: 44g
* Carbs: 38g
* Fat: 10g

🥗 Ingredients (Total: 270g):
* 60g Pita Bread – 162 cal
* 30g Avocado – 47 cal
* 150g Chicken Strips – 196 cal
* 10g Lettuce – 2 cal
* 20g Greek Yogurt (0% fat) – 12 cal

🧑‍🍳 Instructions:
1. Warm the pita bread lightly if desired.
2. Mash the avocado and spread it inside the pita.
3. Add cooked chicken strips (grilled or pan-seared).
4. Top with lettuce and a spoon of Greek yogurt as a creamy, high-protein dressing.
5. Fold or wrap and enjoy fresh!
